messages:
anna_pm: quick sync — after the GA rollout we have a steady trickle of small bugs and a handful of enhancement asks from early adopters. wanted to propose a 2-week postlaunch iteration focused on: (1) customer-critical fixes, (2) 2 highest-impact quick enhancements, (3) telemetry cleanup. thoughts?

matt_eng: +1 on a focused 2-week slab. can we quantify 'customer-critical'? last week support tagged 7 issues as 'blocker' but 4 are edge cases.

liam_sre: support block list: two infra regressions (restart on OOM), one streaming timeout, one incorrect error surface. infra regressions affect Dedicated customers only. streaming timeout is higher p99 for hosted in eu-west.

anna_pm: thanks liam. proposed priority rule: P0 = crash/data-loss/renewal blockers, P1 = usability and major regressions, P2 = nice-to-have enhancements. apply P1 cap of 2 items for the sprint.

tara_design: for the two 'highest-impact enhancements' can we pick items that also reduce support load? e.g., inline prompt templates + clearer error UI would cut questions.

omar_ds: we have telemetry showing the most frequent support paths are around prompt tooling and 'model mismatch' confusion. +1 for prompt templates. also can run a quick cohort eval to validate impact within 48h.

matt_eng: suggested sprint split: Week A = deploy hotfixes (P0/P1 infra + streaming), Week B = ship one enhancement + observability tidy (cost-per-token backfill). estimate: 5 engs -> hotfixes 3 days, streaming fix 2 days, enhancement 6 days, obs tidy 2 days (parallel).

anna_pm: that feels doable. can we keep a tiny ETR bucket for rollback + emergency pad? say 20% capacity for incidents.

liam_sre: yes — recommend 2-hour oncall window for Week A and smoke test checklist pre-deploy. deploy-bot will post canary results.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging -> canary -> prod. Prometheus checks: 5xx increase, p99 latency, memory. Alerts: #eng-oncall.

matt_eng: i'll author the runbook and a simple rollback plan. tara can you draft error UI copy and quick mock by EOD tomorrow?

tara_design: on it. will post in #design and tag you.

anna_pm: ok final decisions: 2-week postlaunch iteration starting Mon. Scope = P0 fixes (all), P1 cap 2 (one infra regression + prompt templates), observability tidy. 20% capacity reserved for incidents. owners: matt (eng), liam (sre), tara (design), omar (datascience eval). I'll send a follow-up OKR-lite and JIRA slices.

matt_eng: sounds good. :thumbsup:

liam_sre: good to go.

omar_ds: will queue evals and share results in 24–48h.

anna_pm: thanks team — aiming to keep iteration tight and unblock customers quickly. will post final Jira and a short kickoff note tonight.
